title: Show one consistent number of decisions waiting on Daniel across HQ
tier_reason: Reversible local work authorized by Daniel; verify the result before completion.
ask:
Implement section 1 of docs/hq/HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md. Daniel authorized this redesign on 2026-09-21. Preserve the acceptance requirements in that section and coordinate with the other sections. Do not duplicate existing deliverable gate w44ff2049d9a.

Follow the reviewed First-card implementation contract at the end of HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md. Extend existing server.waiting_on_you projection; remove double-count/subtraction and competing client readiness arithmetic. Include fixture coverage and live-read API verification. Do not implement a rival artifact gate.
first_action: Read docs/hq/HUMAN_INTERFACE_PLAN.md section 1, inspect the current behavior and linked work, then implement and verify the specified outcome.
source_message: Daniel authorized the HQ redesign cards and a temporary Claude/Codex execution rule, followed by one supervised run.
result: Shared readiness implemented and verified live: Dashboard, navigation and main queue all report 25. The main queue rendered exactly the 25 source IDs in the shared API; dashboard and navigation render summary counts, not individual IDs. Legacy direct-card view reports 23 ready work items plus 2 decisions, with preparation/verification separate. Completed work is separate from prospective completion. Unprepared results have explicit Open links and preserved verdict controls; refresh bypasses stale cache; unavailable data is not presented as empty. Operator follow-up corrections and actual evidence are in docs/hq/COUNTS_VERIFICATION.md. Strict required-source reads now distinguish incomplete data from an empty queue. All nine HQ Python scripts, three JavaScript regressions, and main game suites (2853 unit/968 integration) passed. Committed as 2f281054c0cb1295d171c15206aac9df1798ffae after explicit operator acceptance based on independent reviews; the native review disagreement remains recorded.

check.summary: The shared count and live 25-item agreement are evidenced, but the unavailable-data safeguard cannot detect real work-record read failures and may publish a partial or empty count as authoritative.

findings.what: waiting_on_you() reports available=true after real read failures because work.items() and _read_dir() silently return partial or empty results; the test only mocks an exception the production reader suppresses, so the claimed unavailable-data behavior is unsupported.
findings.fix: Expose read completeness or errors from the work reader, make waiting_on_you() return available=false when any required record or directory cannot be read, and test the real reader with an unreadable/malformed fixture rather than replacing work.items() with a throwing lambda.

prior_results.result:
Implemented one shared definition of work waiting on Daniel.

Dashboard, navigation, and Decisions now use the same server-provided ready IDs and total. Returned decisions reappear after the owner replies; preparing, awaiting-reply, held, scheduled, and completed work stay out of the total with explicit reasons. Unavailable data displays as unknown, not zero. The existing deliverable check was unchanged.

Verified against current records: 4 ready decisions. New state fixtures, existing Work and decision tests, JavaScript syntax checks, and diff checks pass. The sandbox blocked connection to the running HQ process, so HTTP verification will occur after the normal service restart.
